meta.title: Journey times from each LSOA to the proposed Universal resort site (Kempston Hardwick)
meta.publisher: Derived: DfT Bus Open Data Service (BODS) timetables; OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); rail modelled from London Northwestern Railway / Thameslink / EMR published timetables; ONS LSOA 2021 population-weighted centroids; routed with OpenTripPlanner 2
meta.next_update: Re-run when BODS timetables or the Dec 2026 rail timetable change
meta.quality: Modelled journey times, not observed. Routed by OpenTripPlanner 2.8.1 (Docker, batch) over the Geofabrik Bedfordshire OSM extract and BODS GTFS (south_east, east_anglia, east_midlands regional feeds, cut to trips on the modelled day calling within (51.8, -0.8, 52.36, -0.1)). Destination 52.0898,-0.4996 (Kempston Hardwick site; not common.SITE). Origins: 417 of 417 LSOAs use ONS LSOA 2021 population-weighted centroids, the rest geometric centroids. tt_pt_am_min = shortest public-transport+walk journey (leave origin -> reach site) among itineraries arriving 07:30-08:30 (OTP arriveBy 08:30, 60-min search window); the traveller leaves just in time, so it excludes waiting before the first departure and any early-arrival slack at the site (slack_at_site_min in attrs). tt_pt_late_min = minutes from 22:30 (shift end) until arrival home, earliest arrival, so it includes waiting at the site; null if not home by 00:30. tt_pt_late_ok_pct = 100 if home within 90 min (by 00:00). Walk-only answers count as PT only up to 60 min. Walk 1.33 m/s, cycle 5 m/s (18 km/h), 2-min transfer slack, access/egress walk <= 45 min.
meta.limitations: Single modelled weekday (Tue 17 Nov 2026) - school-day timetables; Saturdays/Sundays, school holidays and real-time disruption are not modelled. Car times are free-flow from OSM road speeds and ignore congestion, junction delay and parking (so they understate peak driving times, especially Luton-A6/M1 and Bedford town). Cycle times ignore hills and route quality. One point per LSOA: residents far from the centroid may face longer walks. Demand-responsive transport, works shuttles, taxis and any future resort bus/rail link are excluded. Bus timetables are as registered in BODS (published schedules, not punctuality). Rail is a hand-built GTFS (pipeline/travel/rail_gtfs/): Marston Vale line Bedford-Bletchley Mon-Fri trips transcribed train-by-train from London Northwestern Railway's timetable valid 18 May-11 Dec 2026 (https://www.londonnorthwesternrailway.co.uk/media/44855/download; full hourly train service assumed running as published, after the 2022-24 suspension ended 19 Feb 2024 - no current suspension found, but East West Rail works can bring bus replacement at short notice). Thameslink Bedford-Flitwick-Harlington-Leagrave-Luton-Luton Airport Parkway (every 15 min ~05:15-22:00, then every 30 min; ~25 min end to end) and EMR Connect Bedford-Luton-Luton Airport Parkway (every 30 min, 15 min non-stop) are MODELLED as regular headways (frequencies.txt) from the Summer 2026 (to 12 Dec 2026) weekday pattern; real departures differ by a few minutes and peak-only fast Thameslink trains are omitted. No other rail.
meta.licence: BODS timetable data: Open Government Licence v3.0; OpenStreetMap: Open Database Licence (ODbL) 1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors; ONS centroids & NaPTAN: OGL v3.0; rail timetable facts from operators' published timetables
meta.rail_assumption: Rail is a hand-built GTFS (pipeline/travel/rail_gtfs/): Marston Vale line Bedford-Bletchley Mon-Fri trips transcribed train-by-train from London Northwestern Railway's timetable valid 18 May-11 Dec 2026 (https://www.londonnorthwesternrailway.co.uk/media/44855/download; full hourly train service assumed running as published, after the 2022-24 suspension ended 19 Feb 2024 - no current suspension found, but East West Rail works can bring bus replacement at short notice). Thameslink Bedford-Flitwick-Harlington-Leagrave-Luton-Luton Airport Parkway (southbound every 15 min 05:16-21:47 then every 30 min to 23:45; northbound every 15 min 05:31-00:56; ~25 min end to end) and EMR Connect Bedford-Luton-Luton Airport Parkway (every 30 min, 15 min non-stop) are MODELLED as regular headways (frequencies.txt) from the Summer 2026 (to 12 Dec 2026) weekday pattern; real departures differ by a few minutes and peak-only fast Thameslink trains are omitted. No other rail: in particular no East Coast Main Line (Sandy, Biggleswade, Arlesey), so journeys from east Central Bedfordshire are overstated where rail would help.

indicators.label: Public transport to site, arrive by 08:30 (min)
indicators.description: Shortest bus/rail + walk journey from the LSOA centroid arriving at the site between 07:30 and 08:30 on a typical weekday; null when no journey exists (attrs.no_journey).

indicators.label: Public transport home after 22:30 shift end (min)
indicators.description: Minutes from 22:30 at the site until arrival at the LSOA centroid (earliest arrival, includes waiting); null when not home by 00:30.

indicators.label: Can get home by public transport within 90 min of a 22:30 finish
indicators.description: LSOA: 100 or 0. LA/county: % of residents aged 16-64 living in LSOAs where it is possible (population-weighted, num/den given).

indicators.label: Car to site (min, free-flow)
indicators.description: OTP car routing on OSM roads; no congestion.

indicators.label: Walk to site (min)
indicators.description: OTP walk routing at 4.8 km/h (up to 4 h).

indicators.label: 16-64s within 45 min by public transport (am)
indicators.description: % of residents aged 16-64 (ONS SAPE, mid-2024) in LSOAs with tt_pt_am_min <= 45.

indicators.label: 16-64s within 60 min by public transport (am)
indicators.description: % of residents aged 16-64 in LSOAs with tt_pt_am_min <= 60.

indicators.label: 16-64s within 30 min by car
indicators.description: % of residents aged 16-64 in LSOAs with tt_car_min <= 30 (free-flow).
